details: Spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) experienced substantial outflows, with BlackRock's IBIT recording a $528 million loss and total outflows reaching $733 million on May 28, marking the largest single-day figure since January 29. Analysts attribute this downturn to escalating US-Iran geopolitical tensions, Bitcoin's drop below $73,000, and a general decrease in risk appetite. While Bitcoin saw a modest rebound to $73,300 after dipping, experts warn that the relief may be temporary given continued ETF outflows and broader macroeconomic headwinds.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See Major Outflows as Market Faces Pressure

details: Ethereum (ETH) dropped below the $2,000 mark on May 28, a level not seen since March. This decline coincides with continued bearish sentiment as spot Ether ETFs recorded a $121 million net outflow on the same day, marking the 13th consecutive day of withdrawals. Since May 7, these funds have collectively seen over $470 million in net outflows, and reports indicate that institutional players, including Harvard University's endowment fund, have begun reducing their ETH holdings.
title: Ethereum Falls Below $2K; Spot ETFs See 13th Day of Outflows

details: CME Group is poised to introduce 24/7 trading for its regulated cryptocurrency futures and options market, effective May 29, pending regulatory approval. This structural change is expected to eliminate the "CME gap," a significant technical pattern previously watched by Bitcoin traders. The move underscores robust institutional demand for digital asset risk management, with CME reporting a record $3 trillion in notional volume across its crypto derivatives in 2025.
title: CME Group to Launch 24/7 Crypto Futures Trading, Ending "CME Gap"

details: Raydium, the leading decentralized exchange (DEX) on Solana by trading volume, has seen its native RAY token listed on popular consumer finance platforms Robinhood and Revolut. This significant development makes RAY the first token from a Solana-based DEX to be available on both applications, broadening its accessibility to a wider retail investor base and indicating increasing mainstream acceptance for decentralized finance protocols. Raydium has already facilitated over $1 trillion in cumulative trading volume.
title: Solana's Raydium Token Gains Listings on Robinhood and Revolut
